# AIBytz

> AI automation studio building AI employees, custom automations, and intelligent chatbots that work 24/7. One engineer backed by AI agents — shipping at agency speed for startup costs.

## What we do

AIBytz builds three core solutions for businesses:

1. **AI-Powered Custom Automations** — Eliminate repetitive work. CRM syncing, data entry, report generation, email sequences, operations workflows — built custom for how your business runs.

2. **Pre-Trained AI Employees** — Deploy specialized AI agents (Sales Assistant, Support Agent, Appointment Scheduler, Lead Qualifier) that handle real conversations and work around the clock.

3. **AI Chatbots & Web Integration** — Website live chat, WhatsApp bots, Instagram bots, knowledge-base assistants — trained on your specific products and services.

## The difference

Traditional agencies: bloated teams, months of delivery, high cost.
AIBytz: one AI engineer + AI agents, weeks to ship, 10× faster.

## Process

1. **Discovery Call** — 15 min. We learn how your business runs, where time gets wasted.
2. **Map & Design** — We design custom AI workflows and automation systems for your needs.
3. **Build & Test** — Everything connected to your tools (CRM, WhatsApp, email), tested before launch.
4. **Launch & Optimize** — Live monitoring, performance tuning, edge-case fixes until it runs perfectly.
